notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» is replaced by prev1's names, taken up to أحمد بن محمد; the text writes الحسين بن سيف itself, so the take-over stops before him. The back-reference is not written.
«أخيه علي»: «أخيه» plus a name is one link, the name alone (rule 7); «أبيه» is a relation.
«عن النبي ص» gives the Prophet's words; the Prophet is not a link, so أنس is the last link (rule 12).
